dog.description_text:
Microwave is such a joy…and so sweet…that her full name should be Microwave Joy! This 7-year old, 21-pound nugget is a Tibetan Spaniel mix who is so snuggly, she always wants to be next to you…no matter what!

Microwave is friendly, affectionate, and playful and has plenty of energy. She loves to be by her foster mom's side and is her little shadow.

Microwave loves to snuggle, give kisses, and play with toys and other dogs. She also enjoys going for Microwave and trots beautifully on a leash. She is doing well in a foster home with other dogs. She loves to play with the younger dog and gives the senior dogs their space. She has also done well in a home without other dogs and loved the attention.

Microwave loves people and making new friends, especially if they pet her or give her treats! She is friendly towards other dogs while out on leash. She loves her treats and food and is not a picky eater. She is housetrained.

Skip the candy aisle and bring home your very own Microwave Joy!

If you would like to adopt this dog, please visit www.pupstarzrescue.org for an application!
